label: TRIVIAL
trivial_evidence: server/src/middleware/auth.guard.ts AuthGuard (APP_GUARD in app.module.ts apiMiddleware) throws Error when a route does not declare @Authenticated(); outliers live in MaintenanceModule using MaintenanceAuthGuard
reason: In the API app the global AuthGuard throws 'Route ... does not declare @Authenticated()' for any handler without it, so a missing decorator fails on first request. All 11 outliers are in the maintenance worker, a separate module guarded by MaintenanceAuthGuard (MaintenanceRoute or public by default), outside AuthGuard's scope. Hesitated with ACCEPT (a missing guard there would be worth a look); the check is a repo guard rather than Nest itself.
